Going  into  2026,  it's  the  first  year  in 
 my  life  where  making  more  money  has  not 
 been  my  goal.  Most  of  my  goals  are  very 
 ambitious,  but  I  also  can  recognize  when 
 enough  is  enough.  I  don't  need  to  be  the 
 richest  man  in  the  world.  At  this  point 
 right  now,  I  don't  want  to  only  win  the 
 business  game.  Business  is  a  game 
 and  there  are  mini  games  within  the 
 larger  context  of  the  life  game.  And  I 
 would  prefer  to  win  at  life  than  just 
 win  at  business.
